faq.title: Common budget questions
faq-1.question: How much does Claude Code cost?
faq-1.answer: Claude Code is included with the Pro plan ($17-20/month), Max plans (from $100/month), and Team/Enterprise plans. API access is billed at standard token rates.
faq-2.question: What Claude plans are available?
faq-2.answer: Free gives basic chat access. Pro ($17-20/month) adds Claude Code, Cowork, Design, and Science. Max (from $100/month) offers 5x or 20x more usage. Team ($20-25/seat/month) adds admin controls. Enterprise offers custom pricing.
faq-3.question: Are there ways to reduce API costs?
faq-3.answer: Prompt caching and batch processing can cut API costs by up to 50 percent for repeated or delayed workloads.
